# ⚠️ Auto-generated — DO NOT EDIT

This repository contains the **built output** of the IAYC website (https://iayc.org).
Everything here is machine-generated: every push **overwrites** this branch with a fresh
mirror of `_site/` — manual edits are lost on the next publish.

To change the website, work in the source repo instead:
**[iwaev/iayc-website](https://github.com/iwaev/iayc-website)**

Then deploy from that repo:

```bash
make release    # = make build + make publish
```

`scripts/publish.sh` in the source repo mirrors the freshly built `_site/` into this
repository and pushes it using the deploy key attached to this repo. See the source
repo's README for the full deployment documentation.
